_source: forge/compose/docs/features/COMPOSE-UI-INTEGRATION-1/design.md (STRATUM-CADENCE-UI-AUDIT-1, 2026-10-29). Envelope taken from smart-memory-ops/docs/process/operating-process.md section 4b `ops-event/1`, extended additively (field `provider`, Stratum kinds, snapshot records).
_roadmap: COMPOSE-UI-INTEGRATION-1 units in design.md section 'Units'. Status: DESIGN, not built.
closed: Every object below is additionalProperties:false, as COMP-OBS-CONTRACT/schema.json does. A new field or kind is an additive edit to this file in the same commit as its provider.

fields.event_id: sha256(provider + source_ref), so a re-read is a no-op
fields.ts: ISO-8601 UTC of the original record
fields.provider: enum: cadence-diary | cadence-snapshot | seats | sessions | stratum-flows | stratum-agents | daemons
fields.source: enum from ops-event/1: stamp | job | owner_queue | usage | batch | session | daemon | ledger | cadence | event_log, plus 'stratum'

object.type: enum: unit | job | owner_question | session | seat | review_batch | daemon | flow | step | gate | agent_run

fields.feature_code: string|null: Compose feature code when known
fields.actor: string|null: session name, daemon name, 'owner', or 'stratum'
fields.verdict: enum|null: CLEAN | FINDINGS | READY FOR REVIEW | BLOCKED | INVALID
fields.payload_ref: string|null: absolute path of the record holding the detail (never the content)
fields.extra: object, small scalars only (counts, percents, reason codes); never report bodies, env values or keys

cadence-diary.rule: 1:1 from the diary kind (smart-memory-ops/claude/scripts/ev.py KINDS); to_state from the fixed stamp->state table in operating-process.md section 2
excluded: job.snapshot, job.priority (folded into the job object)

snapshot.rule: Providers whose truth is a current reading (not a history) emit one snapshot record per poll; the read model replaces the previous one for the same (provider, object.type, object.id).

fields.state: object, closed per object.type: seat {pct_5h, pct_7d, reset_5h, reset_7d, fable_pct, codex_pct}; session {name, seat, busy, context_k, tab}; gate_state {name, enabled, last_decision, last_reason}; cadence {launchable, ready, blocked_by: {reason: count}, walls: [name], rung}; unit_wait {unit, reason}
fields.stale_after_s: integer: the UI greys the record after this

entry.name: provider enum
entry.command: argv array, run without a shell; must print JSON lines of ops-event/1 or ops-snapshot/1 on stdout
entry.cursor_arg: string|null: e.g. '--since'; the runner passes the last source_ref it accepted
entry.kill_env: string: env var that turns this provider off when '0'

read_model.join_keys: unit<->job by unit id in job label; job<->agent_run by peerLabel/label; flow<->feature by feature_code or stratumFlowId; session<->seat by seat

api.GET /api/ops/state: the whole projection plus per-provider {last_ok, last_error, cursor}
api.WS /ws/vision message 'opsEvent': one event or snapshot, after it is applied

read_model.storage: in memory, rebuilt from providers on start; optional cache .compose/data/ops-cache.json. Never a second source of truth (the diary and ~/.stratum stay the truth).
read_model.writes: none in v1. Two-way actions (answer owner question, approve Stratum gate, launch) go through their owners' own writers: owner_queue.py, `stratum gate`, `stratum session launch`.

rules: No secrets, no content: pointers only (payload_ref).
Fail visible: a provider that exits non-zero or prints an unparseable line yields provider.error with the line position; the cursor does not move (no-silent-degradation.md).
Free prose (ledger, notes) is never parsed; a prose-only fact gets a typed diary kind first.
Per object, order by ts then source_ref; no cross-object ordering promise.
